reviews.title: Wrongful Ban for impersonating myself - needs human review
reviews.text:
I’ve had my BLK account for YEARS and was a paying Premium member with thousands of potential matches. After uploading a new photo OF MYSELF, my account was suddenly permanently banned for “impersonation and misrepresentation.” Every photo on my profile is me, and all of my profile information is my own. I have never impersonated anyone.

What makes this worse is that BLK’s own notice says automated tools were involved in the decision. Instead of simply asking me to verify my identity or complete a selfie verification, they permanently banned my established account.

I tried contacting support by email and submitting appeals, but I received generic, stock responses instead of someone actually addressing the fact that I am the person in my photos. I even offered to verify my identity.

It’s extremely disappointing that a longtime paying customer can lose an established account over what appears to be an incorrect impersonation flag and then struggle to get meaningful help from customer service. BLK needs a better human review process for false bans.

reviews.title: Pay to play but no real matches. A waste of time and money
reviews.text:
This app feels like it’s designed more to take your money than actually help people connect. You get a limited number of likes and matches, and once you reach that limit, you’re pushed toward paying for a subscription just to continue using basic features.

Even when you do get matches, the experience is disappointing. You can spend hours swiping through profiles without getting any meaningful connections. Many of the people shown don’t even appear to be in your local area, which defeats the purpose of using a dating app to meet people nearby.

On top of that, when you finally do match with someone, most don’t respond. Some might send one message and then disappear completely. It honestly makes me question how many profiles are real and whether bots or inactive accounts are being used to make the app look more active than it actually is.

Overall, the experience feels misleading, frustrating, and designed to encourage people to spend money without delivering real results. I wouldn’t recommend wasting your time or money on this app. It’s been a terrible experience.

reviews.title: Permanent Ban Over a Bra Under a Sheer Shirt? No Warning, No Transparency.
reviews.text:
Honestly disappointed with this app. I was permanently banned over a first-time photo violation for wearing a sheer top with a bra underneath — no nudity involved — and received no warning beforehand. Instead of asking me to remove the photo or temporarily suspending the account, they permanently banned my profile and phone number immediately.

The appeal process feels completely automated and gives no real explanation or transparency. Meanwhile, there are clearly non-Black people and fake profiles on the app despite it being marketed toward Black singles, yet a non-nude photo gets someone fully removed from the platform. On top of that, the app constantly pushes paid features and subscriptions, so it honestly feels more focused on getting people’s money than creating genuine connections.

As a Black woman in Portland, I joined hoping to find genuine connections within the community, but overall the experience was disappointing. This situation honestly reminded me that meeting people organically is probably healthier than relying on dating apps like this.

reviews.title: App needs many changes
reviews.text:
• The city, town, or neighborhood someone is in should be shown on their profile not just “21 miles away”. I’m skeptical any of the people I see are real people because I never see majority of them on other apps.
• The distance preference slider should be able to be adjusted lower than 20 miles. 
• There shouldn’t be a paywall to see the likes you receive. I’m sure it’s designed this way to incentivize you pay for a premium subscription. I’m sure most of the likes are people well outside your distance preference anyways because I’ve been swiping for days and only came across 1 person who was in my likes. 

This app would be a lot better if it were designed a lot more like Hinge. More control on location preference. Location for everyone is on their profile. I can see who likes me and sent an opening message without paying money. I can rewind to the last person without paying. All of these good features on Hinge, not BLK.
